udp_stream.detail: UDP datagram order and bytes preserved

adapter_loopback.detail: Local UDP adapter proxy forwarded one WireGuard-shaped datagram

large_packet_fragmentation.detail: Large payload restored after out-of-order fragment delivery

abnormal_packet_handling.detail: Replay, tamper, and malformed records were dropped

limitations: All traffic data is from real pcap captures — no synthetic WireGuard-shaped payloads.
The outer cryptographic primitive is a standard-library SHAKE stream plus HMAC-SHA256 tag for coursework reproducibility, not a replacement for WireGuard security.
